findings.title: Limit the one-job claim to compilation and disclose parallel configuration
findings.evidence: The environment limits vcpkg build invocations to -j1. The unchanged fmt port omits DISABLE_PARALLEL_CONFIGURE, so the pinned configuration helper creates both Debug and Release tasks and directly invokes Ninja -v without -j1 or a job pool. The whole-install one-job wording therefore overstates the resource limit.
findings.impact: Two CMake configuration processes, including their compiler probes, can overlap inside one manifest install. Admission and documentation must describe that concurrency.
findings.requested_change: Either constrain configuration scheduling through a reviewed mechanism, or retain the ordinary port and explicitly admit one compilation job per build invocation with at most two concurrent Debug/Release configure processes.
findings.parent_disposition: Accepted the latter correction; original frozen finding retained. No corrected delta reviewed here.
findings.evidence_type: Static pinned-source assertion; no native reproduction.

verified_static_behavior: New private directory and distinct per-triplet detector/build/package/installed roots; four ordinary sequential installs with compiler tracking and binary caching disabled.
No --cmake-args/editable/head/dry-run arguments; retained source confirms ordinary ABI computation and one-job build invocation.
Fresh constructed build environment keeps real HOME, clears inherited compiler/cache variables and selects bounded tool paths and qualified pkgconf.
Admission bindings, existing full protected guard, canonical lease, confinement probes, 600-second process-group timeout and final failure/preservation propagation remain present.

Nine detector markers, exact compiler identity/hash/version, both cache configurations and generated compiler metadata, actual compiled-library paths and exact ABI fields are checked. Dynamic dependency output is retained for the later artifact review; consumers remain pending.
scan_limit: One exact content digest independently matched the bound public receipt.

six_new_inspect_cell_controls.method: Only inspect_cell compiled from AST; injected fixture-only digest and inventory stub. Synthetic compiler/library bytes are non-executable; no real prefix inventory or candidate imports.

claude_acceptance_preservation: The four-file maintained change does not touch Claude acceptance. Retained static baseline reports all 19 original files passing; no baseline or OCI rerun by this reviewer.
checks_not_run: Native main/imports, protected guard, census, lease, profile, source-copy or build execution
Fresh host/target compiler selection, actual port caches/ABI, lipo/otool, package consumers or full matrix
Services, containers, installations, network, model sessions or Claude OCI/provider acceptance
native_admission: Not granted; original resource-scope finding requires the narrow correction.
